youtube.description:
Use Kiro in JetBrains, Zed, Neovim via ACP in 3 steps

Three steps to use Kiro inside JetBrains, Zed and more.

1. Install Kiro CLI - The CLI is the agent inside other editors.
2. Run the ACP command - Start it with kiro-cli acp.
3. Connect your editor - JetBrains, Zed, Eclipse, Emacs and Neovim work.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/acp/
